answer: Anchor every identity to a decaying bond, hard as basalt. A new agent locks 40 POA; each epoch the bond sheds 2 POA unless the agent completes verified work, so an idle identity dissolves and must pay again. Bought identities decay without work, so resale buys nothing. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA plus 2,000 per epoch, far more than the fees fakes earn. Honest agents pay once and renew by working, each renewal stamped with an ivory seal.
